raw:
@q query
  select ?p
  where all
    match
      relation "cost per month"
      role subject ?product
      role object ?p
      polarity affirmed
    end
    match
      relation "support"
      role object "500 seats"
      polarity affirmed
    end
  end
  compare ?p1 below ?p2

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "Zendesk Suite Professional"
  role object "?p1"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@a2 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "Freshdesk Pro"
  role object "?p2"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation
